rows.title: Shareholders meeting
rows.summary: Samhi Hotels Limited has submitted the Exchange the voting results pursuant to regulation 44 of the SEBI LODR Regulations along with the consolidated scrutinizer''s report in respect of 16th AGM of the Company for the financial year 2025-26 held on Monday, 31st August 2026 through VC at 02:00 p.m. (IST)  for information & records.

rows.title: Shareholders meeting
rows.summary: Samhi Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the summary of proceedings of the 16th AGM of the members of the Company for the financial year 2025-26 held on Monday, 31st day of August 2026 at 02:00 p.m. (IST) through VC which are enclosed for your kind information & records.
